name: Ninomae Kiichi
source:
3rd year student. Star Sign: Aquarius.
Captain of the Track & Field club.
At first impression he may seem scary, but he is kind and strong and is often relied upon by those around him.
The members of the track & field club are very important to him, and he won't complain about spending time training or studying as long as it's for the sake of the club.
